prompts: An old man with short grey hair and a lined, clean-shaven face, in a long rust-brown wool coat with a patched elbow and brown leather gloves sits on the end of a wooden bench beside a log fire in a stone cottage, leaning toward the fire. Beside him stands a small barefoot boy with long tousled light-brown hair, in a patched grey tunic and patched brown trousers. The boy steps to the bench and sits down beside the man, folding his hands in his lap. The man straightens up and turns his head to look at the boy. The bench creaks as the boy sits. The whole clip is one continuous, unbroken shot from one fixed camera. The camera is locked off and does not move. They are the only two people in the room, the man on the left near the fire and the boy on the right; neither one crosses in front of the other. Audio: the steady crackle and pop of the log fire, no music, no speech.

An old man with short grey hair and a lined, clean-shaven face, in a long rust-brown wool coat with a patched elbow and brown leather gloves sits on the end of a wooden bench beside a log fire in a stone cottage, looking at a small barefoot boy with long tousled light-brown hair, in a patched grey tunic and patched brown trousers who sits beside him. The boy looks at the man, then copies him: he leans forward and rests his forearms on his knees, gazing into the fire. The man watches him and the corner of his mouth lifts. The whole clip is one continuous, unbroken shot from one fixed camera. The camera is locked off and does not move. They are the only two people in the room, the man on the left near the fire and the boy on the right; neither one crosses in front of the other. Audio: the steady crackle and pop of the log fire, no music, no speech.

An old man with short grey hair and a lined, clean-shaven face, in a long rust-brown wool coat with a patched elbow and brown leather gloves sits on the end of a wooden bench beside a log fire in a stone cottage, beside a small barefoot boy with long tousled light-brown hair, in a patched grey tunic and patched brown trousers who leans forward toward the fire. The man pushes himself to his feet, steps to the hearth and rests one gloved hand on the wooden mantel beam, then turns his face toward the camera. The boy sits up and looks up at him. The bench creaks as the man rises. The whole clip is one continuous, unbroken shot from one fixed camera. The camera is locked off and does not move. They are the only two people in the room, the man on the left near the fire and the boy on the right; neither one crosses in front of the other. Audio: the steady crackle and pop of the log fire, no music, no speech.

cast_sentences.P0 (boy, into the man's locked plate): Add the boy from the second image, in his patched grey tunic, standing barefoot at the far right end of the bench with a wide gap of empty floor between him and the man, facing the fire.
cast_sentences.P1 (boy): Add the barefoot boy from the second image, in his patched grey tunic, sitting at the far right end of the bench with a gap of empty bench between him and the man, facing him, his hands in his lap.
cast_sentences.P2 (boy): Add the barefoot boy from the second image, in his patched grey tunic, sitting at the far right end of the bench with a gap of empty bench between him and the man, leaning forward with his elbows on his knees.
cast_sentences.P3 (boy): Add the barefoot boy from the second image, in his patched grey tunic, sitting on the far end of the bench away from the man, looking up at him.
cast_sentences.man, turned toward the boy (P1, P2): Add the man from the second image sitting on the end of the wooden bench nearest the fire, turned to his right, looking along the bench toward the window, his hands resting on his knees.

cast_note: The man: P0 and P3 reuse his one-character P2 (leaning) and P3 (mantel) plates; P1 and P2 use the turned pose below. Each was room-locked with seg_lock.py. The boy was then cast INTO the man's locked plate (a duo cast) and composite with compose.py. Cast alone into the empty room he was placed on the man's spot 4/4; "away from the man" alone did not keep them apart; without "barefoot" he got boots in 3 of 4 plates.
